summary: New box Preterit-wa: example for sense 1 in Preterit-wa (Jan 2.3/346)

data.translation: Khori Brahim: Sir, they hid themselves in caves, stayed for some days, and broke the caves through to one another and gathered together; they went to the houses and escaped. <...>

rationale: First active I.1 Preterit-wa example; caves as bare affected object and reciprocal connection goal. English is supplied project machine translation.

summary: New box Preterit: example for sense 1 in Preterit (Jan 2.3/409)

data.translation: Khori Brahim: He went behind the door, excuse me, to pass water; the gunshot went through the door, entered here, and he was killed.

rationale: First active I.1 Preterit example; feminine gunshot subject with -la and b-marked obstacle. English is supplied project machine translation.

summary: example for sense 2 in Preterit (Jan 2.10/2534)

data.translation: He fell upon him, slash! slash! And behind him, behind him the rifles, bang and bang, and the army was split open before him; he went. <...>

rationale: First Detransitive 2 example; feminine subject and xriqo support Preterit, not a new Part. Pass. box. English is supplied project machine translation.

summary: Aktives xrəqqe trägt l-Agens nach q+l-Angleichung, Patient aus Gürtel-/Halskontext; Detransitive xriq/xrəqno hat bewegtes Subjekt und ʕal-Oberfläche. Beide lexikalischen Werte stehen getrennt von I.1 durchbrechen, dringen.

Jan Beṯ-Şawoce has no edition translation. English accompanying the added examples is the supplied project machine translation, copied and cut without retranslation; lexical decisions rest on the Turoyo.
Round-1 active 2 dragging and Detransitive 1 gliding remain separate and unchanged. New Detransitive 2 returns to the breaking-through domain.
xrəq-la with feminine shot shows an L-series active form. xriq-o with feminine army is instead compatible with the inherited xriq Detransitive Preterit.
Detransitive subject roles vary: the army is split open, while the bullet is the moving penetrator. The label alone does not mean externally caused patient suffering.
xərqowa cannot be assigned to a -wa box merely because the machine English uses a counterfactual. It is not quoted as a secure form example.
JL 16.7/23: genaue Schleifart und notwendiger Bodenkontakt bestätigen. Kopfverweis JL 16.6 bleibt als ungeklärte Editions-/Lesungsangabe, nicht still ersetzen.
LuF 2/32: xrəqno als reduzierte Detransitive-Form zu xriq bestätigen; keine Normalisierung der Quellvokale.
Jan 2.3/397: identify the stem vowel and full paradigm behind xərqowa; Infectum-wa or Preterit-wa?
Jan 2.10/2534: confirm feminine xriqo as Detransitive Preterit; does the army split open, part, or become breached?
Jan 2.10/2541: confirm productive Detransitive kməxrəq for bullet penetration and whether speakers distinguish it lexically from active I.1.
